publication.title: Knowledge Graph Visualization Interface for Digital Heritage Collections: Design Issues and Recommendations

adjudication.basis: Primary peer-reviewed design/system report describes actual property-graph interfaces for associative browsing, incremental expansion, merging query subgraphs and metadata inspection across three digital-humanities deployments.

limitations: Factual relational-information tasks; narrative phase still in progress

descriptions.interaction: Thematic/entity/keyword starting graphs, add-and-merge successive query subgraphs, select metadata, expand neighbours, remove from display, pan/zoom/layout and type filters. Two-node path operations are not implemented in these three interfaces and are future enhancements.
descriptions.guidance: Canned queries and bounded meaningful starting subgraphs, simplified labels, video tour, contextual metadata panels, grouping and filter menus; more comprehensive help recommended.
descriptions.visualisation: Cytoscape.js node-link with meaningful labels/icons, class colour/shape, grouped compound nodes, fCoSE then Force-cola layout; text metadata/related-node panels complement graph.
descriptions.backend: Neo4j/AuraDB labelled property graph and Cypher queries, Node.js/Koa API on Google App Engine, browser Cytoscape.js. RDF/OWL modelling/conversion is content-design history, not native RDF query support in these deployments.
descriptions.evaluation: Three development case studies incorporating preliminary usability observations
